commit 427531b6a80a906bfa3828d48a0dae1f5f18b21f
Author:     Alessandro Castellani <alessandro@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Apr 21 22:16:02 2025 +0000

CommitDate: Mon Apr 21 22:16:02 2025 +0000

    Bug 1961691 - Ensure that the folder picker menupopup is correctly styled. r=laurel,arschmitz
    
    
    #### How to test
    
    - Open the `Settings > Appearance` section.
    - Click on the `Choose >` button at the bottom of the page.
    - Ensure that the menupopup and all its children are visually correct.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246143

diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/appearance.inc.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/appearance.inc.xhtml
index 5f179743a4f..7d8309b41fb 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/appearance.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/appearance.inc.xhtml
@@ -138,11 +138,12 @@
         <button is="highlightable-button" id="applyChoose"
                 class="folder-chooser-popup-button"
                 data-l10n-id="choose-apply-sort-button"></button>
-        <menupopup id="folderPickerMenuPopup">
+        <menupopup id="folderPickerMenuPopup" class="menupopup">
           <menu id="applyViewToFolder"
                 class="apply-view-to-folder-menu"
                 data-l10n-id="apply-current-view-to-folder">
             <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                       class="menupopup"
                        mode="filing"
                        showFileHereLabel="true"
                        position="start_before"></menupopup>
@@ -151,6 +152,7 @@
                 class="apply-view-to-folder-and-children-menu"
                 data-l10n-id="apply-current-view-to-folder-children">
             <menupopup is="folder-menupopup"
+                       class="menupopup"
                        mode="filing"
                        showFileHereLabel="true"
                        showAccountsFileHere="true"
diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/preferences.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/preferences.xhtml
index cf94a4d7be2..95cbe8f62b2 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/preferences.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/preferences.xhtml
@@ -29,6 +29,7 @@
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://global/skin/popup.css" />
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://global/skin/autocomplete.css" />
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/input-fields.css" />
+  <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/widgets.css" />
   <link
     rel="stylesheet"
     href="chrome://messenger/skin/preferences/applications.css"
diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/widgets.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/widgets.css
index c828595348f..be0114f41c3 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/widgets.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/widgets.css
@@ -581,3 +581,10 @@
     }
   }
 }
+
+/* menupopup */
+
+.menupopup {
+  --panel-border-color: var(--in-content-box-border-color);
+  appearance: none;
+}
